_meta.status: initial wording; category and anchor sentences are empirical and may be revised on the development image split only, with every revision recorded below
notes: One prompt list per visual category (vocabulary.json categories with visual_class true).
Pictograms and photographed signs share the same prompts; they are evaluation strata, not separate prompt sets.
Out-of-scope anchors compete with the category prompts in the same similarity ranking; an image whose best match is an anchor is treated as not an airport sign.
lost_property has no visual class in the vocabulary and therefore no prompt.

gate: an airport sign for departure gates
a pictogram of an aeroplane taking off
check_in: an airport sign for check-in desks
a pictogram of a ticket or check-in counter
security: an airport sign for security screening
a pictogram of a security checkpoint with a scanner
baggage: an airport sign for baggage reclaim
a pictogram of a suitcase on a conveyor belt
information: an airport sign for the information desk
a pictogram of a question mark or the letter i for information
lounge: an airport sign for the lounge
a pictogram of a waiting room with a seat
restaurant: an airport sign for a restaurant or cafe
a pictogram of a fork and knife or a coffee cup
restroom: a pictogram of a man and a woman for restrooms
accessibility: an airport sign for assistance for passengers with reduced mobility
a pictogram of a person in a wheelchair
transport: an airport sign for trains, buses, taxis or parking
a pictogram of a bus, a train, a taxi or a car
medical: an airport sign for first aid
a pictogram of a first aid cross

out_of_scope_anchors: a photograph of food on a plate
a boarding pass or printed document
a screenshot of a phone or computer screen
